editorialIntent: Landlocked Paraguay's beach-labelled filtered catalogue consists of a real Uruguay/Paraguay/Brazil/Argentina itinerary. Clearly locate sea beaches in Punta del Este Uruguay (days 4–5); Paraguay part covers Asunción/Chaco/Guairá and lake scenery without promised bathing. Avoid equating Iguazú waterfalls with a beach holiday.

externalSources.supports: January 2024 Paraguayan Ministry of Environment water monitoring found non-bathing conditions at named Lake Ypacaraí beaches. Historical caution only; no claim of 2026 measured conditions.

notes: All offer geography and day-by-day bathing/shore activities derived from actual Ada Tours itinerary. No external source URLs appear in public Markdown; user-facing source links are internal only.
